result.title: What Should an Information Bottleneck Encoder Learn? Separating Representation Learning from Rate Control
result.summary: The information bottleneck (IB) trades compression of an input $X$ against prediction of a target $Y$ through a multiplier $β=1/λ$, yet each operating point is usually served by training, or fully conditioning, a new encoder. For jointly Gaussian data, we show that the IB solution factorizes as $A(β)=D(β)W$: the information-bearing directions $W$ do not depend on $β$, and $β$ acts only through scalar gains. We ask whether this separation of \emph{representation} from \emph{rate control} survives beyond Gaussian models, treating the budget as a given operating parameter rather than a quantity to be optimized. For a budget-free representation \(F(X)\), the \emph{separation gap} is controlled by the \emph{sufficiency deficit} $ε_F=I(X;Y\mid F(X))$: We show there is at least $ε_F$ in the worst case for finite inputs, and it is bounded uniformly in $λ$ by a function of $ε_F$ for finite label alphabets. The same certificate extends to a new target distribution and to pooled multi-domain data, where a conditional-alignment term appears. On MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10 and STL-10 (10 seeds, eight prespecified budgets), a frozen CNN representation with one compressor--decoder pair per budget reduces estimated training multiply--accumulate operations (MACs) by $7.7\times$ and wall-clock time by about $2\times$ relative to end-to-end VIBs, and attains higher budget-averaged accuracy ($65.6\%$ versus $57.3\%$ per domain; $67.1\%$ versus $57.1\%$ pooled), with the advantage concentrated at strong compression, where the VIBs collapse. At weak compression ($λ\le0.036$), VIB has higher cross-entropy and ECE; its surrogate Lagrangian is higher per domain, indistinguishable from the pooled VIB in the macro average, and lower on the pooled test set.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究信息瓶颈中表示学习与率控制能否分离：高斯情形下 IB 解分解为与 β 无关的信息方向与标量增益，并给出由充分性缺陷 ε_F 控制的分离间隙界，在四个图像分类数据集上比较冻结表示配逐预算压缩器与端到端 VIB。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「充分性缺陷」ε_F=I(X;Y|F(X)) 提供任务必要信息保留程度的量化诊断，可能供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留视觉证据、以及强压缩下表示坍缩；但论文不涉及多模态推理，迁移需较多核查。
